cover.headline: Swiss officials: AI agents got in *every time*. Patch in *24 hours*.
cover.sub: The NCSC on every AI-agent attack it knows of, 24 Nov. Plus Microsoft's 6 ARTEX users, Google's 1 Feb agent deadline and OpenAI's Monday shutdown.

items.title: Swiss officials: every AI-agent attack they saw *got in*
items.statLabel: the NCSC's limit for installing critical patches on internet-facing systems
items.what: 24 Nov: the Swiss NCSC confirmed its first attacks run with AI agents, on firms and critical infrastructure in at least two sectors. All it knows of succeeded.
items.why: The agents used guessable passwords and known holes. Patch exposed systems within 24 hours of a critical fix, and put MFA or passkeys on webmail and VPN.

items.title: *6* groups now attack with one open-source AI agent
items.statLabel: threat actors Microsoft has seen adding ARTEX to their tools, Salt Typhoon among them
items.what: 25 Nov: ARTEX, an open-source AI pentest platform, gets from recon to privileged access in minutes. One campaign peaked at 2,900 failed sign-ins a minute.
items.why: Machine-speed bursts are the tell. Rate-limit, put your WAF in prevention mode and plant decoys: in Microsoft's tests they cut traffic to real assets.

items.title: Google gives AI agents their *own door* into Gmail
items.statLabel: 2027: from then, agents reach Workspace via Google's MCP servers or CLI, not REST
items.what: 24 Nov, per the CSA and others: Workspace MCP servers and a CLI went GA, with new API terms for AI agents. Google's guide adds a separate agent OAuth flag.
items.why: If your agent reads Gmail, Drive or Calendar over REST, plan the move now. Give it its own OAuth client, marked as an AI-powered agent.

items.title: OpenAI's prompt objects and Agent Builder stop *Monday*
items.statLabel: OpenAI API cut-off dates between 30 Nov and 15 Dec
items.what: 30 Nov: prompt objects and Agent Builder shut down and Evals goes read-only. Image models follow on 1 Dec, then gpt-5 and o3 on 11 Dec. Notice came in May and June.
items.why: Move prompts into your code, export eval sets and pick replacement models now. Fine-tuned models stop on the same date as their base model.

courses.title: OWASP API Security Top 10: Secure Your APIs
courses.note: freeCodeCamp, 1.5 hours with Corey Ball on all ten 2023 risks, from broken object level authorization to SSRF. Posted Aug 2023, so not new.

courses.title: Learn How To Secure API Servers
courses.note: freeCodeCamp, 1 hour from APIsec Labs' Anthony Aragues: CORS, leaks, path traversal and rate limiting. Posted Sep 2024.

read: Attack agents need *minutes*. Switzerland wants critical patches in *24 hours*. Google gives agents until *1 Feb*. OpenAI's cut-off is *Monday*.
takeaway: This week: a 24-hour patch rule, agent-flagged OAuth clients, and OpenAI prompts moved into code.
